# Acceptance fixture provenance

All fixtures in this directory are synthetic and may be redistributed under
[CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

- `synthetic-maintenance-note.txt` was authored for this repository on 2026-08-30. Names, measurements, and dates are invented and contain no operational or personal data.
- `synthetic-inspection.png.base64` is a base64-encoded, programmatically generated 1 x 1 PNG. It has no source photograph, embedded metadata, personal data, or third-party content. Acceptance tooling decodes it in memory before upload.

These files are test inputs only. They are not evidence of an actual inspection or safe operating limits.
